title: Genetic evidence for the causal effects of malocclusion and dental attrition on temporomandibular disorders: A multivariable Mendelian randomization study
html: The causal role of occlusal factors, particularly malocclusion and dental attrition, in temporomandibular disorders (TMDs) remains unclear because of inconsistent observational evidence and confounding influences, limiting definitive conclusions regarding their independent etiological contributions.
